critical_code_review_comments: StreamVods.tsx line 30: window.open(r.url, '_blank') is called AFTER an awaited fetch — some browsers (especially Safari/iOS) block popups because the gesture context is lost. Consider opening a blank window on click first, then assigning .location, or use a hidden <a target=_blank download href={url}>.click() pattern.

streaming.py download_vod: when exp exists but equal to now the branch evaluates to 410 (acceptable) but the message 'This recording is not available for download.' is identical for 409/410 — could differentiate 'expired' vs 'not ready yet' for clearer UX.

Stories.tsx ProfileStoryAvatar: tap handler onTap always opens chooser — matches the spec. Minor: the backdrop uses z-[88] which is correct (bottom-nav z-40). Portal into document.body avoids any transform/overflow stacking context issues from the Profile scroll container. Good.

rca_of_the_issue: User-reported bug 'tapping avatar never pulls up view picture / view story': confirmed fixed. The ProfileStoryAvatar component now unconditionally opens the chooser bottom-sheet on tap (previously it only opened the story viewer when has_active_story was true, so profiles without a story had no tappable action). The chooser is rendered via createPortal into document.body with z-[88] — above the mobile bottom-nav (z-40) and outside the Profile's scroll container, which also fixes the touch-pan-y overflow trap that could have swallowed clicks. Disabled options with helper text ('No active story' / 'No photo yet') make the behaviour discoverable even when neither resource exists.
